NBL Rosetta Teams

Source: R/nbl_rosetta.R
nbl_rosetta_teams.Rd

Every team record of an organisation: current, defunct, exhibition and development sides.

Endpoint: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/{org}/teams

Usage

nbl_rosetta_teams(org = "nbl", limit = NULL)

Arguments

org

(character default "nbl"): Organisation: nbl (men's NBL), wnbl (women's) or nbl1 (the second tier, men's and women's conferences). One of "nbl", "wnbl", "nbl1".

limit

(integer default NULL): Rows to return. Omitted = a page large enough for the whole list (a short page cut by Rosetta's path cache is refused).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble (one row per team record):

col_nametypedescription
orgcharacterOrganisation the row belongs to: nbl, wnbl or nbl1. From the row's competition, else from the request.
team_idcharacterDataCore team id (UUID v1); stable across seasons.
rosetta_team_idcharacterRosetta team id (UUID v4; v5 on NBL1); stable across seasons; accepted as {team_id}.
namecharacterTeam name as Rosetta spells it, e.g. Perth Wildcats.
team_codecharacterTeam code, e.g. PER (the {team_code} path value)
establishedcharacterYear the club was founded; often null.
head_coachcharacterHead coach; often null.
championshipscharacterChampionships won; often null.
websitecharacterClub website URL.
external_media_competitor_idcharacterTeam id on the media/OTT service; often null.
conferencecharacterNBL1 conference of the team (name); null for NBL and WNBL teams.
divisioncharacterNBL1 division of the team (name); null for NBL and WNBL teams.
venue_namecharacterName of the venue (arena), e.g. RAC Arena.
venue_addresscharacterUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_statecharacterUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_countrycharacterUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_timezonecharacterIANA time zone of the venue, e.g. Australia/Sydney.
venue_latitudenumericUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_longitudenumericUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_capacityintegerUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
conference_namecharacterName of the NBL1 conference the team plays in (e.g. North, South); null outside NBL1.
division_namecharacterDivision name (NBL1 conference + gender)

Columns the body adds beyond these follow, in body order (sdv-py keeps them too).

Details

  • Unofficial: the JSON proxy behind nbl.com.au (not an API the NBL documents or supports). The terms of use were not reviewed; payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Gated by a referer, not a key: every request carries Origin / Referer set to nbl.com.au (the runtime sends them); without them the host answers 403 MISSING_API_KEY, which is raised as hoopR_asset_fetch.

  • Fills a hole in ESPN: ESPN's nbl feed has box scores but no plays for the 2025-26 NBL season (the stats provider changed from Genius Sports to Sportradar DataCore that year). nbl_rosetta_match_pbp has the full event log with shot x/y for 2025-26 and, in the same shape, back to 2011-12 (WNBL about 2014-15). Matches from 1979 have box scores only.

  • One host serves three organisations; pass org='nbl' (default), 'wnbl' or 'nbl1'. NBL1 is the second tier (men's and women's conferences, calendar-year seasons).

  • Season = the END year (2026 = 2025-26) everywhere. Rosetta's own year is the START year for the NBL and WNBL from 1998-99 and a calendar year for NBL1 and the 1979-1997 winter seasons; the runtime maps it. Year 1998 holds two seasons (calendar 1998 and 1998-99).

  • Ids: <entity>id columns are DataCore ids (UUID v1; join on them), rosetta<entity>_id Rosetta's own. match_id is the DataCore fixture id every match route is keyed on.

  • Unknown ids, orgs and types answer 200 with no rows (hoopR_no_data). Rosetta caches a body per path and serves it whatever the query string, so a page cut by someone else's limit is refused (hoopR_asset_fetch); retry after the cache entry expires.

Errors: hoopR_no_data when Rosetta answers 404 or no rows (an unknown match, team, player or season id, an org or season type with nothing, or no season in progress); hoopR_asset_fetch for the 403 gate body, a stub or error envelope, a page cut by Rosetta's path cache, a body for another org, season or entity than the one asked for, or any other failed fetch; hoopR_bad_request for an unknown org / season_type, a malformed id, or HTTP 400 / 422.

See also

Other NBL Rosetta: nbl_rosetta_match(), nbl_rosetta_match_by_id(), nbl_rosetta_match_pbp(), nbl_rosetta_match_player_box(), nbl_rosetta_match_player_period_box(), nbl_rosetta_match_team_box(), nbl_rosetta_matches(), nbl_rosetta_next_match(), nbl_rosetta_next_match_team(), nbl_rosetta_next_matches(), nbl_rosetta_outcomes(), nbl_rosetta_player_game_log(), nbl_rosetta_player_stats(), nbl_rosetta_players(), nbl_rosetta_seasons(), nbl_rosetta_seasons_current(), nbl_rosetta_standings(), nbl_rosetta_stats_leaders(), nbl_rosetta_team_players(), nbl_rosetta_team_stats(), nbl_rosetta_team_stats_leaders()
